(async () => {
  const assert = (condition, message) => { if (!condition) throw Error(message); };
  const wait = async predicate => { const deadline = Date.now()+8000; while (!predicate()) { if (Date.now()>deadline) throw Error('UI wait timed out'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,30)); } };
  await wait(() => document.getElementById('connection').textContent.includes('ready'));
  assert(document.getElementById('interpret').disabled,'Blank drawing should not interpret');
  document.querySelector('[data-demo="compass"]').click();
  await wait(() => !document.getElementById('execute').disabled);
  assert(document.getElementById('planTitle').textContent.includes('Open'),'Compass demo not loaded');
  assert(document.getElementById('sourceBadge').textContent==='PRESET DEMO','Demo must be labeled');
  document.getElementById('execute').click();
  await wait(() => document.getElementById('planBadge').textContent==='REHEARSAL COMPLETE');
  await wait(() => !document.getElementById('execute').disabled);
  assert(document.getElementById('runCount').textContent==='0','Rehearsal should not count real actions');
  document.getElementById('hint').value='a new idea';
  document.getElementById('hint').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
  assert(document.getElementById('execute').disabled,'Hint edits must invalidate plans');
  let rejected=false;
  try { await window.doodle.execute({rehearsal:true}); } catch { rejected=true; }
  assert(rejected,'Main process must reject the stale plan');
  document.getElementById('undo').click();
  assert(!document.getElementById('redo').disabled,'Undo should enable redo');
  document.getElementById('redo').click();
  assert(document.getElementById('redo').disabled,'Redo should restore last stroke');
  document.querySelector('[data-color="#df654c"]').click();
  assert(document.querySelector('[data-color="#df654c"]').getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true','Color not selected');
  const c=document.getElementById('canvas'), bounds=c.getBoundingClientRect();
  const capture=c.setPointerCapture; c.setPointerCapture=()=>{};
  const event=(type,x,y)=>new PointerEvent(type,{pointerId:101,pointerType:'pen',clientX:bounds.left+x* bounds.width/1400,clientY:bounds.top+y*bounds.height/800,bubbles:true});
  document.getElementById('pen').click();
  c.dispatchEvent(event('pointerdown',100,100)); c.dispatchEvent(event('pointerup',100,100));
  assert(c.getContext('2d').getImageData(100,100,1,1).data[3]>0,'Pen must draw visible ink');
  document.getElementById('eraser').click();
  c.dispatchEvent(event('pointerdown',100,100)); c.dispatchEvent(event('pointerup',100,100));
  assert(c.getContext('2d').getImageData(100,100,1,1).data[3]===0,'Eraser must remove ink, not paint white');
  c.setPointerCapture=capture;
  document.getElementById('settingsButton').click();
  assert(document.getElementById('settings').open,'Settings did not open');
  const originalProvider=document.getElementById('provider').value;
  document.getElementById('key').value='a-typed-session-key';
  document.getElementById('provider').value=originalProvider==='gemini'?'openai':'gemini';
  document.getElementById('provider').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  assert(document.getElementById('key').value==='','Switching providers must clear the typed key');
  assert(document.getElementById('model').value===(originalProvider==='gemini'?'gpt-4.1-mini':'gemini-3.8-flash'),'Switching providers must select its own model');
  document.getElementById('provider').value=originalProvider; document.getElementById('provider').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  document.getElementById('closeSettings').click();
  document.getElementById('newChallenge').click();
  assert(!document.getElementById('challenge').hidden,'Challenge should be visible');
  assert(document.getElementById('timer').textContent==='0:30','Challenge timer should wait for first stroke');
  document.getElementById('dismissChallenge').click();
  document.querySelector('.gallery-item').click();
  assert(document.getElementById('execute').disabled,'Restoring gallery must require reinterpretation');
  document.querySelector('[data-demo="music"]').click();
  await wait(() => !document.getElementById('execute').disabled);
  document.getElementById('execute').click();
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));
  document.getElementById('stop').click();
  await wait(() => document.getElementById('stop').disabled);
  assert(document.getElementById('status').textContent.includes('Stopped'),'Rehearsal should be stoppable');
  document.querySelector('[data-demo="tab"]').click();
  await wait(() => !document.getElementById('execute').disabled);
  assert(!document.getElementById('targetNote').hidden,'Keyboard targeting note missing');
  assert(document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-item').length>=3,'Sketch gallery should record guesses');
  const overflow = document.documentElement.scrollWidth>window.innerWidth;
  assert(!overflow,'Page overflows horizontally');
  return {title:document.title,demos:true,rehearsal:true,cancellation:true,stalePlanRejected:true,undoRedo:true,challenge:true,gallery:true,platform:(await window.doodle.info()).platform};
})()
